newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa loses steam as NY disappoints bulls.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa loses steam as NY disappoints bulls.

text.p: London cocoa futures' attempt to gain upside momentum turned sour on Friday after New York slipped from the edge of a key chart resistance, traders said.

London marched higher in the morning on trade buying and short covering, calling New York higher in a bid to help the March contract there fill a key chart gap between $1,404 and $1,408. But New York's failure to extend the rally clipped London's wings and March cocoa closed at an unchanged 925 stg a tonne after reaching a session high of 935 stg.
Traders said the close could overshadow the market next week.
"People were looking for New York to through at least that gap. But it has failed again. It just can't fill that gap," said one trader.

The gap is crucial because traders expect buy stops to be triggered immediately above it at $1,410, which can then pave the way for further gains. In London, the main buyers in December were SFH, Cargill and Phibro. Volume totalled a moderate 6,615 lots and the Dec/March switch traded at 34-35 stg.
Ivorian arrivals will be entering a more critical stage in the coming weeks as end-November and December figures are regarded more as guidelines to the size of the main crop.
Attention will also focus on the CFTC Commitment of Traders Report due after the close of business in New York and traders expect an increase in speculative short positions.
But the report will not have taken into account the possible short covering done in the last few days.
